 """Steady-state geothermal-heated n-butane power-loop flowsheet."""
 
 from __future__ import annotations
 
 import pyomo.environ as pyo
 from pyomo.network import Arc, SequentialDecomposition
 from pyomo.util.infeasible import log_infeasible_bounds, log_infeasible_constraints
 
 import idaes.logger as idaeslog
 from ahuora_builder.custom.custom_heat_exchanger import CustomHeatExchanger
 from ahuora_builder.custom.updated_pressure_changer import Pump, Turbine
 from ahuora_property_packages.helmholtz.helmholtz_builder import build_helmholtz_package
 from idaes.core import FlowsheetBlock
 from idaes.core.solvers import get_solver
 from idaes.core.util.model_statistics import degrees_of_freedom
 from idaes.models.unit_models import Mixer, MomentumMixingType
 from idaes.core.util.model_diagnostics import DiagnosticsToolbox
 
 
 TIME = 0
 
 
 def build_geothermal_plant() -> pyo.ConcreteModel:
     """Build, connect, and specify the geothermal power-loop model."""
     model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
     model.fs = FlowsheetBlock(dynamic=False)
     setup_model(model)
     specify_model(model)
     return model
 
 
 def setup_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
     """Create property packages, unit operations, and process arcs."""
     fs = model.fs
     fs.butane = build_helmholtz_package(["n-butane"])
     fs.water = build_helmholtz_package(["water"])
     fs.pump = Pump(property_package=fs.butane)
     fs.turbine = Turbine(property_package=fs.butane)
     fs.recuperator = CustomHeatExchanger(
         hot_side_name="shell",
         cold_side_name="tube",
         shell={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
         tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
     )
     fs.preheater = CustomHeatExchanger(
         hot_side_name="shell",
         cold_side_name="tube",
         shell={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
         tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
     )
     fs.vaporiser = CustomHeatExchanger(
         hot_side_name="shell",
         cold_side_name="tube",
         shell={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
         tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
     )
     fs.condenser = CustomHeatExchanger(
         hot_side_name="shell",
         cold_side_name="tube",
         shell={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
         tube={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
     )
     fs.water_mixer = Mixer(
         property_package=fs.water,
         inlet_list=["geothermal", "auxiliary"],
         momentum_mixing_type=MomentumMixingType.minimize,
     )
     fs.condenser_to_pump = Arc(source=fs.condenser.shell_outlet, destination=fs.pump.inlet)
     fs.pump_to_recuperator = Arc(source=fs.pump.outlet, destination=fs.recuperator.tube_inlet)
     fs.recuperator_to_preheater = Arc(source=fs.recuperator.tube_outlet, destination=fs.preheater.tube_inlet)
     fs.preheater_to_vaporiser = Arc(source=fs.preheater.tube_outlet, destination=fs.vaporiser.tube_inlet)
     fs.vaporiser_to_turbine = Arc(source=fs.vaporiser.tube_outlet, destination=fs.turbine.inlet)
     fs.turbine_to_recuperator = Arc(source=fs.turbine.outlet, destination=fs.recuperator.shell_inlet)
     fs.recuperator_to_condenser = Arc(source=fs.recuperator.shell_outlet, destination=fs.condenser.shell_inlet)
     fs.vaporiser_to_mixer = Arc(source=fs.vaporiser.shell_outlet, destination=fs.water_mixer.geothermal)
     fs.mixer_to_preheater = Arc(source=fs.water_mixer.outlet, destination=fs.preheater.shell_inlet)
     pyo.TransformationFactory("network.expand_arcs").apply_to(model)
 
 
 def specify_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
     """fix variables and set guesses"""
     fs = model.fs
     butane = fs.butane
     water = fs.water
 
     # The flow circulation rate required deactivating the flow equality constraint
     # to allow it to anchor the flow rate.
     # This is the only variable that needs to be fixed like this.
     fs.pump.inlet.pressure[TIME].set_value(100.0e5)
     fs.condenser_to_pump.expanded_block.flow_mol_equality.deactivate()
     fs.pump.inlet.flow_mol.fix(1.0)
 
     # This provides an example of fixing an inlet port conditions.
     fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.flow_mol.fix(770.9510005)
     fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.pressure.fix(23.0e5)
     fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.enth_mol.fix(
         pyo.value(water.htpx(T=473.15 * pyo.units.K, p=23.0e5 * pyo.units.Pa)),
     )
-    # This provides an example of fixing outlet temperature. Temperature is an expression in helmholtz
-    # property packages so we have to get it as a variable to fix it.
-    condenser_outlet_temperature = fs.condenser.shell.properties_out[TIME].get_as_var(
-        fs.condenser.shell.properties_out[TIME].temperature
+    # Temperature is an expression in Helmholtz property packages, so constrain it
+    # through the state block to let heat-exchanger initialization relax it temporarily.
+    fs.condenser.shell.properties_out[TIME].constrain_component(
+        fs.condenser.shell.properties_out[TIME].temperature, 274.970330261
     )
-    condenser_outlet_temperature.fix(274.970330261)
 
-    # CONTINUE IMPLEMENTING HERE.
+    fs.pump.efficiency_pump.fix(0.7)
+    fs.pump.outlet.pressure.fix(23.0e5)
+    fs.pump.inlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(-2.4e4)
+    fs.pump.outlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(-2.5e4)
 
+    fs.turbine.efficiency_isentropic.fix(0.5)
+    fs.turbine.outlet.pressure.fix(100.0e5)
 
+    fs.recuperator.area.fix(1.0)
+    fs.recuperator.hot_side.deltaP.fix(0.0)
+    fs.recuperator.cold_side.deltaP.fix(0.0)
+    fs.recuperator.tube.properties_out[TIME].constrain_component(
+        fs.recuperator.tube.properties_out[TIME].temperature, 333.15
+    )
+    fs.recuperator.shell_inlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(1.3e4)
+    fs.recuperator.shell_outlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(4.0e3)
+    fs.recuperator.tube_inlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(-2.5e4)
+    fs.recuperator.tube_outlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(-1.6e4)
 
+    fs.preheater.area.fix(5.0)
+    fs.preheater.hot_side.deltaP.fix(0.0)
+    fs.preheater.cold_side.deltaP.fix(0.0)
+    fs.preheater.tube.properties_out[TIME].constrain_component(
+        fs.preheater.tube.properties_out[TIME].temperature, 353.15
+    )
+    fs.preheater.shell_inlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(1.4e4)
+    fs.preheater.shell_outlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(1.4e4)
+    fs.preheater.tube_inlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(-1.6e4)
+    fs.preheater.tube_outlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(-1.3e4)
 
+    fs.vaporiser.area.fix(5.0)
+    fs.vaporiser.hot_side.deltaP.fix(0.0)
+    fs.vaporiser.cold_side.deltaP.fix(0.0)
+    fs.vaporiser.tube.properties_out[TIME].constrain_component(
+        fs.vaporiser.tube.properties_out[TIME].temperature, 423.15
+    )
+    fs.vaporiser.shell_outlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(1.5e4)
+    fs.vaporiser.tube_inlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(-1.3e4)
+    fs.vaporiser.tube_outlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(1.1e4)
 
+    fs.condenser.area.fix(5.0)
+    fs.condenser.hot_side.deltaP.fix(0.0)
+    fs.condenser.cold_side.deltaP.fix(0.0)
+    fs.condenser.tube_inlet.flow_mol.fix(800.0)
+    fs.condenser.tube_inlet.pressure.fix(100.0e3)
+    fs.condenser.tube_inlet.enth_mol.fix(
+        pyo.value(water.htpx(T=274.15 * pyo.units.K, p=100.0e3 * pyo.units.Pa)),
+    )
+    fs.condenser.shell_inlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(4.0e3)
+    fs.condenser.shell_outlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(-2.4e4)
+    fs.condenser.tube_outlet.enth_mol[TIME].set_value(1.1e2)
 
+    fs.water_mixer.auxiliary.flow_mol[TIME].set_value(150.0)
+    fs.water_mixer.auxiliary.pressure.fix(150.0e3)
+    fs.water_mixer.auxiliary.enth_mol.fix(
+        pyo.value(water.htpx(T=368.15 * pyo.units.K, p=150.0e3 * pyo.units.Pa)),
+    )
+    # With no water side-stream through the preheater, this is its specified 60 t/h outlet flow.
+    fs.water_mixer.outlet.flow_mol.fix(925.1412006)
+
+
+
+
+
+
     debug_model(model)
     if degrees_of_freedom(model) != 0:
         raise RuntimeError("The fully specified model must have zero degrees of freedom.")
 
 
 def debug_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
     """Print the model's structural degree-of-freedom status."""
     fs = model.fs
     print(f"Degrees of freedom: {degrees_of_freedom(model)}")
     dt = DiagnosticsToolbox(model)
     dt.display_overconstrained_set()
     dt.display_underconstrained_set()
     fs.pump.report()
     fs.turbine.report()
     fs.recuperator.report()
     fs.preheater.report()
     fs.vaporiser.report()
     fs.condenser.report()
 
 
 
 def initialise_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
     """Initialize in sequential order."""
     fs = model.fs
     sequence = SequentialDecomposition(run_first_pass=True)
     sequence.options.tear_method = "Wegstein"
     sequence.options.iterLim = 5
     sequence.options.tol = 1e-6
     sequence.options.solve_tears = False
     graph = sequence.create_graph(model)
     tears = sequence.tear_set_arcs(graph, method="heuristic")
     sequence.set_tear_set(tears)
     for tear in tears:
         sequence.set_guesses_for(
             tear.destination,
             {
                 name: {TIME: pyo.value(variable[TIME])}
                 for name, variable in tear.destination.vars.items()
                 if TIME in variable
             },
         )
     print("Initialising model with sequential decomposition...")
     sequence.run(model, lambda unit: unit.initialize(outlvl=idaeslog.INFO))
 
 
 def diagnose_failed_solve(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
     """Print infeasibilities and custom unit diagnostics after a failed solve."""
     logger = idaeslog.getLogger(__name__)
     log_infeasible_constraints(model, tol=1e-6, logger=logger)
     log_infeasible_bounds(model, tol=1e-6, logger=logger)
     print("Diagnosing failed solve...")
     for unit in model.fs.component_data_objects(pyo.Block, descend_into=False, active=True):
         if not hasattr(unit, "diagnose"):
             continue
         try:
             for component, message in unit.diagnose():
                 print(f"Unit diagnostic [{component.name}]: {message}")
         except Exception as error:
             print(f"Unit diagnostic [{unit.name}]: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
 
 
 def solve(model: pyo.ConcreteModel | None = None):
     """Build, initialize, and solve the geothermal power-loop model."""
     model = build_geothermal_plant() if model is None else model
     initialise_model(model)
     print("Performing final solve...")
     results = get_solver().solve(model, tee=True, load_solutions=False)
     if results.solver.termination_condition != pyo.TerminationCondition.optimal:
         diagnose_failed_solve(model)
         raise RuntimeError(f"Final solve failed: {results.solver.termination_condition}")
     model.solutions.load_from(results)
     return model, results
 
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     solved_model, _results = solve()

"""Steady-state geothermal-heated n-butane power-loop flowsheet."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pyomo.environ as pyo
from pyomo.network import Arc, SequentialDecomposition
from pyomo.util.infeasible import log_infeasible_bounds, log_infeasible_constraints

import idaes.logger as idaeslog
from ahuora_builder.custom.custom_heat_exchanger import CustomHeatExchanger
from ahuora_builder.custom.updated_pressure_changer import Pump, Turbine
from ahuora_property_packages.helmholtz.helmholtz_builder import build_helmholtz_package
from idaes.core import FlowsheetBlock
from idaes.core.solvers import get_solver
from idaes.core.util.model_statistics import degrees_of_freedom
from idaes.models.unit_models import Mixer, MomentumMixingType
from idaes.core.util.model_diagnostics import DiagnosticsToolbox


TIME = 0


def build_geothermal_plant() -> pyo.ConcreteModel:
    """Build, connect, and specify the geothermal power-loop model."""
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
    model.fs = FlowsheetBlock(dynamic=False)
    setup_model(model)
    specify_model(model)
    return model


def setup_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
    """Create property packages, unit operations, and process arcs."""
    fs = model.fs
    fs.butane = build_helmholtz_package(["n-butane"])
    fs.water = build_helmholtz_package(["water"])
    fs.pump = Pump(property_package=fs.butane)
    fs.turbine = Turbine(property_package=fs.butane)
    fs.recuperator = CustomHeatExchanger(
        hot_side_name="shell",
        cold_side_name="tube",
        shell={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
        tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
    )
    fs.preheater = CustomHeatExchanger(
        hot_side_name="shell",
        cold_side_name="tube",
        shell={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
        tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
    )
    fs.vaporiser = CustomHeatExchanger(
        hot_side_name="shell",
        cold_side_name="tube",
        shell={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
        tube={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
    )
    fs.condenser = CustomHeatExchanger(
        hot_side_name="shell",
        cold_side_name="tube",
        shell={"property_package": fs.butane, "has_pressure_change": True},
        tube={"property_package": fs.water, "has_pressure_change": True},
    )
    fs.water_mixer = Mixer(
        property_package=fs.water,
        inlet_list=["geothermal", "auxiliary"],
        momentum_mixing_type=MomentumMixingType.minimize,
    )
    fs.condenser_to_pump = Arc(source=fs.condenser.shell_outlet, destination=fs.pump.inlet)
    fs.pump_to_recuperator = Arc(source=fs.pump.outlet, destination=fs.recuperator.tube_inlet)
    fs.recuperator_to_preheater = Arc(source=fs.recuperator.tube_outlet, destination=fs.preheater.tube_inlet)
    fs.preheater_to_vaporiser = Arc(source=fs.preheater.tube_outlet, destination=fs.vaporiser.tube_inlet)
    fs.vaporiser_to_turbine = Arc(source=fs.vaporiser.tube_outlet, destination=fs.turbine.inlet)
    fs.turbine_to_recuperator = Arc(source=fs.turbine.outlet, destination=fs.recuperator.shell_inlet)
    fs.recuperator_to_condenser = Arc(source=fs.recuperator.shell_outlet, destination=fs.condenser.shell_inlet)
    fs.vaporiser_to_mixer = Arc(source=fs.vaporiser.shell_outlet, destination=fs.water_mixer.geothermal)
    fs.mixer_to_preheater = Arc(source=fs.water_mixer.outlet, destination=fs.preheater.shell_inlet)
    pyo.TransformationFactory("network.expand_arcs").apply_to(model)


def specify_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
    """fix variables and set guesses"""
    fs = model.fs
    butane = fs.butane
    water = fs.water

    # The flow circulation rate required deactivating the flow equality constraint
    # to allow it to anchor the flow rate.
    # This is the only variable that needs to be fixed like this.
    fs.pump.inlet.pressure[TIME].set_value(100.0e5)
    fs.condenser_to_pump.expanded_block.flow_mol_equality.deactivate()
    fs.pump.inlet.flow_mol.fix(1.0)

    # This provides an example of fixing an inlet port conditions.
    fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.flow_mol.fix(770.9510005)
    fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.pressure.fix(23.0e5)
    fs.vaporiser.shell_inlet.enth_mol.fix(
        pyo.value(water.htpx(T=473.15 * pyo.units.K, p=23.0e5 * pyo.units.Pa)),
    )
    # This provides an example of fixing outlet temperature. Temperature is an expression in helmholtz
    # property packages so we have to get it as a variable to fix it.
    condenser_outlet_temperature = fs.condenser.shell.properties_out[TIME].get_as_var(
        fs.condenser.shell.properties_out[TIME].temperature
    )
    condenser_outlet_temperature.fix(274.970330261)

    # CONTINUE IMPLEMENTING HERE.






    debug_model(model)
    if degrees_of_freedom(model) != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("The fully specified model must have zero degrees of freedom.")


def debug_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
    """Print the model's structural degree-of-freedom status."""
    fs = model.fs
    print(f"Degrees of freedom: {degrees_of_freedom(model)}")
    dt = DiagnosticsToolbox(model)
    dt.display_overconstrained_set()
    dt.display_underconstrained_set()
    fs.pump.report()
    fs.turbine.report()
    fs.recuperator.report()
    fs.preheater.report()
    fs.vaporiser.report()
    fs.condenser.report()



def initialise_model(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
    """Initialize in sequential order."""
    fs = model.fs
    sequence = SequentialDecomposition(run_first_pass=True)
    sequence.options.tear_method = "Wegstein"
    sequence.options.iterLim = 5
    sequence.options.tol = 1e-6
    sequence.options.solve_tears = False
    graph = sequence.create_graph(model)
    tears = sequence.tear_set_arcs(graph, method="heuristic")
    sequence.set_tear_set(tears)
    for tear in tears:
        sequence.set_guesses_for(
            tear.destination,
            {
                name: {TIME: pyo.value(variable[TIME])}
                for name, variable in tear.destination.vars.items()
                if TIME in variable
            },
        )
    print("Initialising model with sequential decomposition...")
    sequence.run(model, lambda unit: unit.initialize(outlvl=idaeslog.INFO))


def diagnose_failed_solve(model: pyo.ConcreteModel) -> None:
    """Print infeasibilities and custom unit diagnostics after a failed solve."""
    logger = idaeslog.getLogger(__name__)
    log_infeasible_constraints(model, tol=1e-6, logger=logger)
    log_infeasible_bounds(model, tol=1e-6, logger=logger)
    print("Diagnosing failed solve...")
    for unit in model.fs.component_data_objects(pyo.Block, descend_into=False, active=True):
        if not hasattr(unit, "diagnose"):
            continue
        try:
            for component, message in unit.diagnose():
                print(f"Unit diagnostic [{component.name}]: {message}")
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"Unit diagnostic [{unit.name}]: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")


def solve(model: pyo.ConcreteModel | None = None):
    """Build, initialize, and solve the geothermal power-loop model."""
    model = build_geothermal_plant() if model is None else model
    initialise_model(model)
    print("Performing final solve...")
    results = get_solver().solve(model, tee=True, load_solutions=False)
    if results.solver.termination_condition != pyo.TerminationCondition.optimal:
        diagnose_failed_solve(model)
        raise RuntimeError(f"Final solve failed: {results.solver.termination_condition}")
    model.solutions.load_from(results)
    return model, results


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solved_model, _results = solve()

1: # Geothermal-Heat Organic Power Loop
2: 
3: ## Purpose and modelling basis
4: 
5: This steady-state process model represents a closed, pure n-butane power loop
6: heated by a once-through geothermal-water surrogate and cooled by a separate
7: water utility. Heat is supplied in a preheater and vaporiser; heat from the
8: post-turbine organic stream is recovered in a recuperator. No chemical reaction,
9: mass transfer between process sides, or mixing of n-butane with water is
10: modelled.
11: 
12: The geothermal stream is **pure water**, not brine: salts, non-condensable
13: gases, scaling, and brine-property effects are absent. Both fluids use a
14: Helmholtz-equation-of-state property package with liquid and vapour phases:
15: 
16: | Fluid circuit | Component definition | Phases represented |
17: |---|---|---|
18: | Organic working fluid | 100 mol% n-butane | liquid, vapour |
19: | Geothermal and cooling-water streams | 100 mol% water | liquid, vapour |
20: 
21: All equipment is represented at steady state. The heat exchangers use specified
22: area and an overall heat-transfer relationship; exchanger pressure drops are
23: specified as zero. No exchanger geometry beyond area, heat-loss model, piping
24: drop, pump curve, turbine map, mechanical design, or control system is supplied.
25: 
26: ## Process configuration
27: 
28: ### Organic working-fluid circuit
29: 
30: The 1 mol/s n-butane circuit follows this physical sequence:
31: 
32: `condenser -> Pump1 -> recuperator cold side -> preheater cold side -> vaporiser cold side -> Turbine1 -> recuperator hot side -> condenser`
33: 
34: The condenser produces liquid n-butane, the pump changes its pressure, the
35: recuperator and geothermal exchangers heat it, and the vaporiser outlet is sent
36: to the turbine. The turbine discharge gives up heat to the pressurised liquid or
37: subcooled/partly heated side of the recuperator before returning to the
38: condenser.
39: 
40: The specified pressure directions must be retained exactly when recreating this
41: case, even though they are opposite to conventional pump and turbine service:
42: 
43: | Organic section | Inlet pressure | Outlet pressure | Pressure change |
44: |---|---:|---:|---:|
45: | Pump1 | 100 bar | 23 bar | -77 bar (-7.70 MPa) |
46: | Vaporiser, cold side | 23 bar | 23 bar | 0 kPa |
47: | Turbine1 | 23 bar | 100 bar | +77 bar (+7.70 MPa) |
48: | Recuperator, hot side | 100 bar | 100 bar | 0 kPa |
49: | Condenser, hot side | 100 bar | 100 bar | 0 kPa |
50: 
51: Thus, the saved solution is not a physically conventional pressure-raising pump
52: followed by an expanding turbine. It is a mathematical process configuration
53: with a pressure-reducing unit named Pump1 and a pressure-increasing unit named
54: Turbine1.
55: 
56: ### Geothermal-water circuit
57: 
58: Pure water at 50 t/h, 200 degC, and 23 bar enters the hot side of the vaporiser.
59: It transfers heat to n-butane, then combines with a second pure-water stream at
60: 95 degC and 150 kPa. The combined water passes through the hot side of the
61: preheater and leaves the process.
62: 
63: The second water stream is determined by the total preheater hot-side outlet
64: flow specification of 60 t/h. Consequently, with the 50 t/h geothermal feed,
65: the solved auxiliary-water rate is 154.1902001 mol/s, approximately 10 t/h.
66: The modelled mixer outlet and the preheater hot side are at 150 kPa. This
67: implicitly reduces the 23-bar vaporiser effluent to the lower mixing pressure;
68: no valve or other pressure-letdown equipment is represented.
69: 
70: ### Cooling-water circuit
71: 
72: Separate pure cooling water enters the condenser cold side at 800 mol/s, 1.0000
73: degC, and 100 kPa. It absorbs the condenser duty and exits as a utility return.
74: There is no specified temperature, pressure, or flow adjustment at the return;
75: the condenser cold-side pressure drop is zero.
76: 
77: ## Boundary Conditions and Design Specifications
78: 
79: ### Independently specified feeds and product condition
80: 
81: | Location | Fluid | Specified condition |
82: |---|---|---|
83: | Pump1 inlet / condenser organic outlet | n-butane | 1.0000 mol/s, 100 mol% n-butane, 1.820330261 degC, 100.0000000 bar, vapour fraction = 0 |
84: | Vaporiser hot-side inlet | water | 50.0000 t/h, 100 mol% water, 200.0000000 degC, 23.0000000 bar |
85: | Auxiliary mixer inlet | water | 100 mol% water, 95.0000000 degC, 150.0000 kPa; flow is set by the 60 t/h combined-water condition |
86: | Preheater hot-side outlet | water | 60.0000 t/h total water flow |
87: | Condenser cold-side inlet | water | 800.0000 mol/s, 100 mol% water, 1.000000000 degC, 100.0000 kPa |
88: | Condenser hot-side outlet | n-butane | vapour fraction = 0 |
89: 
90: ### Unit-operation specifications
91: 
92: | Unit operation | Process-side service | Fixed specifications |
93: |---|---|---|
94: | Pump1 | n-butane | Isentropic pump efficiency = 0.7000; outlet pressure = 23.0000000 bar |
95: | Vaporiser | Water hot side; n-butane cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane outlet temperature = 150.0000000 degC; water-side and n-butane-side pressure drops = 0 kPa |
96: | Preheater | Water hot side; n-butane cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane outlet temperature = 80.0000000 degC; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
97: | Recuperator | n-butane hot and cold sides | Area = 1.0000 m2; n-butane cold-side outlet temperature = 60.0000000 degC; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
98: | Condenser | n-butane hot side; water cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane hot-side outlet vapour fraction = 0; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
99: | Turbine1 | n-butane | Isentropic calculation; isentropic efficiency = 0.5000; motor efficiency = 1.0000; outlet pressure = 100.0000000 bar |
100: | Mixer | water | Two inlets, no heat or shaft work specified; combined outlet flow is governed by the 60 t/h downstream specification |
101: 
102: The saved overall heat-transfer coefficients are 61.11845911 W/(m2.K) for the
103: vaporiser, 15.60345335 W/(m2.K) for the preheater, 53.09910952 W/(m2.K) for the
104: recuperator, and 161.3163204 W/(m2.K) for the condenser. They are saved
105: initialization/solved values rather than independent design inputs; the outlet
106: targets above are paired with the exchanger heat-transfer equations.
107: 
108: ## Process Equations and Closure
109: 
110: For each exchanger, the energy balance is
111: 
112: \[
113: Q_{\mathrm{cold}} = -Q_{\mathrm{hot}}
114: \]
115: 
116: and the heat-transfer relation is represented by
117: 
118: \[
119: Q = U A \Delta T_{\mathrm{lm}}, \qquad
120: \Delta T_{\mathrm{lm}} =
121: \frac{\Delta T_1-\Delta T_2}{\ln(\Delta T_1/\Delta T_2)}.
122: \]
123: 
124: Each exchanger additionally conserves component flow on each side and uses the
125: specified zero pressure drop. The water mixer obeys total mass and enthalpy
126: balances,
127: 
128: \[
129: \dot m_{out}=\dot m_1+\dot m_2, \qquad
130: \dot m_{out}h_{out}=\dot m_1h_1+\dot m_2h_2,
131: \]
132: 
133: with its outlet at the lower inlet pressure in the saved solution (150 kPa).
134: 
135: The pump and turbine use material and energy balances, their specified pressure
136: changes, and the stated efficiencies. The isentropic turbine relationship may
137: be expressed as
138: 
139: \[
140: \eta_{is}=\frac{h_{in}-h_{out}}{h_{in}-h_{out,s}},
141: \]
142: 
143: using the model's sign and pressure conventions. The saved pressure rise across
144: the unit called Turbine1 makes the resulting enthalpy and work directions
145: unconventional; the equation should therefore be implemented according to the
146: chosen simulator's turbine convention and checked against the results below.
147: 
148: In process terms, the case is closed by the n-butane circulation rate and
149: condenser liquid condition, the two organic pressure levels, three organic
150: heater outlet-temperature targets, the condenser vapour-fraction target, the
151: three external water-feed conditions, and the 60 t/h mixed-water flow. Heat
152: duties, the auxiliary-water rate, exchanger coefficients, unprescribed outlet
153: states, and shaft powers are calculated. No optimization, rating calculation,
154: or dynamic accumulation is included.
155: 
156: ## Saved Results and Reproduction Checks
157: 
158: The following values are saved solved/initialization results. They are useful
159: for reproducing this exact case, but values identified above as calculated are
160: not additional design specifications.
161: 
162: ### Heat duties and temperature approaches
163: 
164: Positive duty denotes heat received by the cold side.
165: 
166: | Exchanger | Heat duty to cold side (kW) | Temperature difference at one end (degC) | Temperature difference at other end (degC) |
167: |---|---:|---:|---:|
168: | Vaporiser | 24.39085075 | 50.00000000 | 119.6088786 |
169: | Preheater | 3.163201216 | 31.36334627 | 51.36334285 |
170: | Recuperator | 8.982202672 | 158.7379939 | 180.0268024 |
171: | Condenser | 28.13397564 | 175.4808630 | 0.8203302612 |
172: 
173: The geothermal-water exchangers supply 27.55405196 kW in total. The recuperator
174: recovers 8.982202672 kW internally. The cooling-water utility receives
175: 28.13397564 kW.
176: 
177: ### Organic-stream checks
178: 
179: Enthalpies below are the saved property-package values in J/mol; their zero is
180: the property package reference state.
181: 
182: | Organic location | Flow (mol/s) | Pressure (bar) | Temperature if specified (degC) | Enthalpy (J/mol) |
183: |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
184: | Condenser outlet / Pump1 inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | 1.820330261 | -24341.82120 |
185: | Pump1 outlet / recuperator cold inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | not specified | -25396.44445 |
186: | Recuperator cold outlet / preheater inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 60.00000000 | -16414.24178 |
187: | Preheater cold outlet / vaporiser inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 80.00000000 | -13251.04057 |
188: | Vaporiser cold outlet / Turbine1 inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 150.0000000 | 11139.81018 |
189: | Turbine1 outlet / recuperator hot inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | not specified | 12774.35711 |
190: | Recuperator hot outlet / condenser inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | not specified | 3792.154442 |
191: 
192: The saved Pump1 mechanical work is -1.054623259 kW and the saved Turbine1
193: mechanical and electrical work is +1.634546934 kW. Their algebraic sum is
194: **+0.579923675 kW**. These are reported with the model's work signs, not
195: relabelled as conventional power consumption or generation.
196: 
197: ### Water-stream checks
198: 
199: | Water location | Flow (mol/s) | Pressure | Temperature if specified (degC) | Enthalpy (J/mol) |
200: |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
201: | Vaporiser water inlet | 770.9510005 | 23 bar | 200.0000000 | 15358.06828 |
202: | Vaporiser water outlet / first mixer inlet | 770.9510005 | 23 bar | 199.6088786 | 15326.43092 |
203: | Auxiliary mixer inlet | 154.1902001 | 150 kPa | 95.00000000 | 7172.033816 |
204: | Mixer outlet / preheater water inlet | 925.1412006 | 150 kPa | not specified | 13967.36474 |
205: | Preheater water outlet | 925.1412006 | 150 kPa | not specified | 13963.94558 |
206: | Condenser cooling-water inlet | 800.0000000 | 100 kPa | 1.000000000 | 77.05317402 |
207: | Condenser cooling-water outlet | 800.0000000 | 100 kPa | not specified | 112.2206436 |
208: 
209: ## Limits of Interpretation
210: 
211: The model encodes pure-water heat-source and utility streams, so it cannot
212: predict brine salinity effects, flashing caused by dissolved solids, corrosion,
213: scaling, or actual geothermal-well hydraulics. The saved 23-bar-to-150-kPa

# Geothermal-Heat Organic Power Loop

## Purpose and modelling basis

This steady-state process model represents a closed, pure n-butane power loop
heated by a once-through geothermal-water surrogate and cooled by a separate
water utility. Heat is supplied in a preheater and vaporiser; heat from the
post-turbine organic stream is recovered in a recuperator. No chemical reaction,
mass transfer between process sides, or mixing of n-butane with water is
modelled.

The geothermal stream is **pure water**, not brine: salts, non-condensable
gases, scaling, and brine-property effects are absent. Both fluids use a
Helmholtz-equation-of-state property package with liquid and vapour phases:

| Fluid circuit | Component definition | Phases represented |
|---|---|---|
| Organic working fluid | 100 mol% n-butane | liquid, vapour |
| Geothermal and cooling-water streams | 100 mol% water | liquid, vapour |

All equipment is represented at steady state. The heat exchangers use specified
area and an overall heat-transfer relationship; exchanger pressure drops are
specified as zero. No exchanger geometry beyond area, heat-loss model, piping
drop, pump curve, turbine map, mechanical design, or control system is supplied.

## Process configuration

### Organic working-fluid circuit

The 1 mol/s n-butane circuit follows this physical sequence:

`condenser -> Pump1 -> recuperator cold side -> preheater cold side -> vaporiser cold side -> Turbine1 -> recuperator hot side -> condenser`

The condenser produces liquid n-butane, the pump changes its pressure, the
recuperator and geothermal exchangers heat it, and the vaporiser outlet is sent
to the turbine. The turbine discharge gives up heat to the pressurised liquid or
subcooled/partly heated side of the recuperator before returning to the
condenser.

The specified pressure directions must be retained exactly when recreating this
case, even though they are opposite to conventional pump and turbine service:

| Organic section | Inlet pressure | Outlet pressure | Pressure change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Pump1 | 100 bar | 23 bar | -77 bar (-7.70 MPa) |
| Vaporiser, cold side | 23 bar | 23 bar | 0 kPa |
| Turbine1 | 23 bar | 100 bar | +77 bar (+7.70 MPa) |
| Recuperator, hot side | 100 bar | 100 bar | 0 kPa |
| Condenser, hot side | 100 bar | 100 bar | 0 kPa |

Thus, the saved solution is not a physically conventional pressure-raising pump
followed by an expanding turbine. It is a mathematical process configuration
with a pressure-reducing unit named Pump1 and a pressure-increasing unit named
Turbine1.

### Geothermal-water circuit

Pure water at 50 t/h, 200 degC, and 23 bar enters the hot side of the vaporiser.
It transfers heat to n-butane, then combines with a second pure-water stream at
95 degC and 150 kPa. The combined water passes through the hot side of the
preheater and leaves the process.

The second water stream is determined by the total preheater hot-side outlet
flow specification of 60 t/h. Consequently, with the 50 t/h geothermal feed,
the solved auxiliary-water rate is 154.1902001 mol/s, approximately 10 t/h.
The modelled mixer outlet and the preheater hot side are at 150 kPa. This
implicitly reduces the 23-bar vaporiser effluent to the lower mixing pressure;
no valve or other pressure-letdown equipment is represented.

### Cooling-water circuit

Separate pure cooling water enters the condenser cold side at 800 mol/s, 1.0000
degC, and 100 kPa. It absorbs the condenser duty and exits as a utility return.
There is no specified temperature, pressure, or flow adjustment at the return;
the condenser cold-side pressure drop is zero.

## Boundary Conditions and Design Specifications

### Independently specified feeds and product condition

| Location | Fluid | Specified condition |
|---|---|---|
| Pump1 inlet / condenser organic outlet | n-butane | 1.0000 mol/s, 100 mol% n-butane, 1.820330261 degC, 100.0000000 bar, vapour fraction = 0 |
| Vaporiser hot-side inlet | water | 50.0000 t/h, 100 mol% water, 200.0000000 degC, 23.0000000 bar |
| Auxiliary mixer inlet | water | 100 mol% water, 95.0000000 degC, 150.0000 kPa; flow is set by the 60 t/h combined-water condition |
| Preheater hot-side outlet | water | 60.0000 t/h total water flow |
| Condenser cold-side inlet | water | 800.0000 mol/s, 100 mol% water, 1.000000000 degC, 100.0000 kPa |
| Condenser hot-side outlet | n-butane | vapour fraction = 0 |

### Unit-operation specifications

| Unit operation | Process-side service | Fixed specifications |
|---|---|---|
| Pump1 | n-butane | Isentropic pump efficiency = 0.7000; outlet pressure = 23.0000000 bar |
| Vaporiser | Water hot side; n-butane cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane outlet temperature = 150.0000000 degC; water-side and n-butane-side pressure drops = 0 kPa |
| Preheater | Water hot side; n-butane cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane outlet temperature = 80.0000000 degC; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
| Recuperator | n-butane hot and cold sides | Area = 1.0000 m2; n-butane cold-side outlet temperature = 60.0000000 degC; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
| Condenser | n-butane hot side; water cold side | Area = 5.0000 m2; n-butane hot-side outlet vapour fraction = 0; pressure drops = 0 kPa on both sides |
| Turbine1 | n-butane | Isentropic calculation; isentropic efficiency = 0.5000; motor efficiency = 1.0000; outlet pressure = 100.0000000 bar |
| Mixer | water | Two inlets, no heat or shaft work specified; combined outlet flow is governed by the 60 t/h downstream specification |

The saved overall heat-transfer coefficients are 61.11845911 W/(m2.K) for the
vaporiser, 15.60345335 W/(m2.K) for the preheater, 53.09910952 W/(m2.K) for the
recuperator, and 161.3163204 W/(m2.K) for the condenser. They are saved
initialization/solved values rather than independent design inputs; the outlet
targets above are paired with the exchanger heat-transfer equations.

## Process Equations and Closure

For each exchanger, the energy balance is

\[
Q_{\mathrm{cold}} = -Q_{\mathrm{hot}}
\]

and the heat-transfer relation is represented by

\[
Q = U A \Delta T_{\mathrm{lm}}, \qquad
\Delta T_{\mathrm{lm}} =
\frac{\Delta T_1-\Delta T_2}{\ln(\Delta T_1/\Delta T_2)}.
\]

Each exchanger additionally conserves component flow on each side and uses the
specified zero pressure drop. The water mixer obeys total mass and enthalpy
balances,

\[
\dot m_{out}=\dot m_1+\dot m_2, \qquad
\dot m_{out}h_{out}=\dot m_1h_1+\dot m_2h_2,
\]

with its outlet at the lower inlet pressure in the saved solution (150 kPa).

The pump and turbine use material and energy balances, their specified pressure
changes, and the stated efficiencies. The isentropic turbine relationship may
be expressed as

\[
\eta_{is}=\frac{h_{in}-h_{out}}{h_{in}-h_{out,s}},
\]

using the model's sign and pressure conventions. The saved pressure rise across
the unit called Turbine1 makes the resulting enthalpy and work directions
unconventional; the equation should therefore be implemented according to the
chosen simulator's turbine convention and checked against the results below.

In process terms, the case is closed by the n-butane circulation rate and
condenser liquid condition, the two organic pressure levels, three organic
heater outlet-temperature targets, the condenser vapour-fraction target, the
three external water-feed conditions, and the 60 t/h mixed-water flow. Heat
duties, the auxiliary-water rate, exchanger coefficients, unprescribed outlet
states, and shaft powers are calculated. No optimization, rating calculation,
or dynamic accumulation is included.

## Saved Results and Reproduction Checks

The following values are saved solved/initialization results. They are useful
for reproducing this exact case, but values identified above as calculated are
not additional design specifications.

### Heat duties and temperature approaches

Positive duty denotes heat received by the cold side.

| Exchanger | Heat duty to cold side (kW) | Temperature difference at one end (degC) | Temperature difference at other end (degC) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Vaporiser | 24.39085075 | 50.00000000 | 119.6088786 |
| Preheater | 3.163201216 | 31.36334627 | 51.36334285 |
| Recuperator | 8.982202672 | 158.7379939 | 180.0268024 |
| Condenser | 28.13397564 | 175.4808630 | 0.8203302612 |

The geothermal-water exchangers supply 27.55405196 kW in total. The recuperator
recovers 8.982202672 kW internally. The cooling-water utility receives
28.13397564 kW.

### Organic-stream checks

Enthalpies below are the saved property-package values in J/mol; their zero is
the property package reference state.

| Organic location | Flow (mol/s) | Pressure (bar) | Temperature if specified (degC) | Enthalpy (J/mol) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Condenser outlet / Pump1 inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | 1.820330261 | -24341.82120 |
| Pump1 outlet / recuperator cold inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | not specified | -25396.44445 |
| Recuperator cold outlet / preheater inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 60.00000000 | -16414.24178 |
| Preheater cold outlet / vaporiser inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 80.00000000 | -13251.04057 |
| Vaporiser cold outlet / Turbine1 inlet | 1.0000 | 23 | 150.0000000 | 11139.81018 |
| Turbine1 outlet / recuperator hot inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | not specified | 12774.35711 |
| Recuperator hot outlet / condenser inlet | 1.0000 | 100 | not specified | 3792.154442 |

The saved Pump1 mechanical work is -1.054623259 kW and the saved Turbine1
mechanical and electrical work is +1.634546934 kW. Their algebraic sum is
**+0.579923675 kW**. These are reported with the model's work signs, not
relabelled as conventional power consumption or generation.

### Water-stream checks

| Water location | Flow (mol/s) | Pressure | Temperature if specified (degC) | Enthalpy (J/mol) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Vaporiser water inlet | 770.9510005 | 23 bar | 200.0000000 | 15358.06828 |
| Vaporiser water outlet / first mixer inlet | 770.9510005 | 23 bar | 199.6088786 | 15326.43092 |
| Auxiliary mixer inlet | 154.1902001 | 150 kPa | 95.00000000 | 7172.033816 |
| Mixer outlet / preheater water inlet | 925.1412006 | 150 kPa | not specified | 13967.36474 |
| Preheater water outlet | 925.1412006 | 150 kPa | not specified | 13963.94558 |
| Condenser cooling-water inlet | 800.0000000 | 100 kPa | 1.000000000 | 77.05317402 |
| Condenser cooling-water outlet | 800.0000000 | 100 kPa | not specified | 112.2206436 |

## Limits of Interpretation

The model encodes pure-water heat-source and utility streams, so it cannot
predict brine salinity effects, flashing caused by dissolved solids, corrosion,
scaling, or actual geothermal-well hydraulics. The saved 23-bar-to-150-kPa
water pressure change occurs at mixing without represented equipment. Most
importantly, the pump/turbine pressure and work directions are internally
unconventional. The tabulated values reproduce the encoded case, but a physical
plant design would need the pressure-changing equipment and its energy signs
reviewed before using the results for equipment sizing or power production.

56:     def build(self,*args,**kwargs) -> None:
57:         """

59:         """
60:         super().build(*args,**kwargs)
61:         # Add an inverted DeltaP

65:     def initialize_build(
66:         self,
67:         state_args_1=None,
68:         state_args_2=None,
69:         outlvl=idaeslog.NOTSET,
70:         solver=None,
71:         optarg=None,
72:         duty=None,
73:     ):
74:         """
75:         Heat exchanger initialization method.
76: 
77:         Args:
78:             state_args_1 : a dict of arguments to be passed to the property
79:                 initialization for the hot side (see documentation of the specific
80:                 property package) (default = {}).
81:             state_args_2 : a dict of arguments to be passed to the property
82:                 initialization for the cold side (see documentation of the specific
83:                 property package) (default = {}).
84:             outlvl : sets output level of initialization routine
85:             optarg : solver options dictionary object (default=None, use
86:                      default solver options)
87:             solver : str indicating which solver to use during
88:                      initialization (default = None, use default solver)
89:             duty : an initial guess for the amount of heat transferred. This
90:                 should be a tuple in the form (value, units), (default
91:                 = (1000 J/s))
92: 
93:         Returns:
94:             None
95: 
96:         """
97:         # So, when solving with a correct area, there can be problems
98:         # That's because if the area's even slightly too large, it becomes infeasible
99:         if not self.area.fixed:
100:             self.area.value = self.area.value * 0.8
101: 
102:         initialise_inverted(self.hot_side, "deltaP")
103:         initialise_inverted(self.cold_side, "deltaP")
104: 
105:         # Set solver options
106:         init_log = idaeslog.getInitLogger(self.name, outlvl, tag="unit")
107:         solve_log = idaeslog.getSolveLogger(self.name, outlvl, tag="unit")
108: 
109:         # Create solver
110:         opt = get_solver(solver, optarg)
111: 
112:         flags1 = self.hot_side.initialize(
113:             outlvl=outlvl, optarg=optarg, solver=solver, state_args=state_args_1
114:         )
115: 
116: 
117:         init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 1a (hot side) Complete.")
118: 
119:         flags2 = self.cold_side.initialize(
120:             outlvl=outlvl, optarg=optarg, solver=solver, state_args=state_args_2
121:         )
122:         init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 1b (cold side) Complete.")
123:         # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
124:         # Solve unit without heat transfer equation
125:         self.heat_transfer_equation.deactivate()
126:         # Deactivate any additional constraints added to constrain outlet temperature/vapor fraction etc during initialisation.
127:         if hasattr( self.cold_side.properties_out, "_deactivate_additional_constraints"):
128:             self.cold_side.properties_out._deactivate_additional_constraints()
129:         if hasattr( self.hot_side.properties_out, "_deactivate_additional_constraints"):
130:             self.hot_side.properties_out._deactivate_additional_constraints()
131: 
132:         # Get side 1 and side 2 heat units, and convert duty as needed
133:         s1_units = self.hot_side.heat.get_units()
134:         s2_units = self.cold_side.heat.get_units()
135: 
136:         # Check to see if heat duty is fixed
137:         # WE will assume that if the first point is fixed, it is fixed at all points
138:         if not self.cold_side.heat[self.flowsheet().time.first()].fixed:
139:             cs_fixed = False
140:             if duty is None:
141:                 # Assume 1000 J/s and check for unitless properties
142:                 if s1_units is None and s2_units is None:
143:                     # Backwards compatibility for unitless properties
144:                     s1_duty = -1000
145:                     s2_duty = 1000
146:                 else:
147:                     s1_duty = pyunits.convert_value(
148:                         -1000, from_units=pyunits.W, to_units=s1_units
149:                     )
150:                     s2_duty = pyunits.convert_value(
151:                         1000, from_units=pyunits.W, to_units=s2_units
152:                     )
153:             else:
154:                 # Duty provided with explicit units
155:                 s1_duty = -pyunits.convert_value(
156:                     duty[0], from_units=duty[1], to_units=s1_units
157:                 )
158:                 s2_duty = pyunits.convert_value(
159:                     duty[0], from_units=duty[1], to_units=s2_units
160:                 )
161: 
162:             self.cold_side.heat.fix(s2_duty)
163:             for i in self.hot_side.heat:
164:                 self.hot_side.heat[i].value = s1_duty
165:         else:
166:             cs_fixed = True
167:             for i in self.hot_side.heat:
168:                 self.hot_side.heat[i].set_value(self.cold_side.heat[i])
169:         with idaeslog.solver_log(solve_log, idaeslog.DEBUG) as slc:
170:             res = opt.solve(self, tee=slc.tee)
171:         init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 2 {}.".format(idaeslog.condition(res)))
172:         if not cs_fixed:
173:             self.cold_side.heat.unfix()
174: 
175: 
176:         if hasattr( self.cold_side.properties_out, "_reactivate_additional_constraints"):
177:             self.cold_side.properties_out._reactivate_additional_constraints()
178:         if hasattr( self.hot_side.properties_out, "_reactivate_additional_constraints"):
179:             self.hot_side.properties_out._reactivate_additional_constraints()
180:         self.heat_transfer_equation.activate()
181: 
182:         # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

192:

# Import Pyomo libraries
from pyomo.environ import (
    Block,

from pyomo.common.config import ConfigBlock, ConfigValue, In
from pyomo.core.base.component import Component

# Import IDAES cores
from idaes.core import (
    declare_process_block_class,
    UnitModelBlockData,
)

import idaes.logger as idaeslog
from idaes.core.util.functions import functions_lib
from idaes.core.util.tables import create_stream_table_dataframe
from idaes.models.unit_models.heater import (
    _make_heater_config_block,
    _make_heater_control_volume,
)

from idaes.core.util.misc import add_object_reference
from idaes.core.util import scaling as iscale
from idaes.core.solvers import get_solver
from idaes.core.util.exceptions import ConfigurationError, InitializationError
from idaes.core.initialization import SingleControlVolumeUnitInitializer
from idaes.models.unit_models.heat_exchanger import HX0DInitializer, _make_heat_exchanger_config, HeatExchangerData, delta_temperature_underwood_callback
from .inverted import add_inverted, initialise_inverted
_log = idaeslog.getLogger(__name__)


@declare_process_block_class("CustomHeatExchanger", doc="Simple 0D heat exchanger model.")
class CustomHeatExchangerData(HeatExchangerData):

    CONFIG = HeatExchangerData.CONFIG()
    CONFIG.pop("delta_temperature_callback")
    CONFIG.declare(
        "delta_temperature_callback",
        ConfigValue(
            default=delta_temperature_underwood_callback,
            description="Callback for for temperature difference calculations",
        ),
    )

    def build(self,*args,**kwargs) -> None:
        """
        Begin building model.
        """
        super().build(*args,**kwargs)
        # Add an inverted DeltaP
        add_inverted(self.hot_side, "deltaP")
        add_inverted(self.cold_side, "deltaP")

    def initialize_build(
        self,
        state_args_1=None,
        state_args_2=None,
        outlvl=idaeslog.NOTSET,
        solver=None,
        optarg=None,
        duty=None,
    ):
        """
        Heat exchanger initialization method.

        Args:
            state_args_1 : a dict of arguments to be passed to the property
                initialization for the hot side (see documentation of the specific
                property package) (default = {}).
            state_args_2 : a dict of arguments to be passed to the property
                initialization for the cold side (see documentation of the specific
                property package) (default = {}).
            outlvl : sets output level of initialization routine
            optarg : solver options dictionary object (default=None, use
                     default solver options)
            solver : str indicating which solver to use during
                     initialization (default = None, use default solver)
            duty : an initial guess for the amount of heat transferred. This
                should be a tuple in the form (value, units), (default
                = (1000 J/s))

        Returns:
            None

        """
        # So, when solving with a correct area, there can be problems
        # That's because if the area's even slightly too large, it becomes infeasible
        if not self.area.fixed:
            self.area.value = self.area.value * 0.8

        initialise_inverted(self.hot_side, "deltaP")
        initialise_inverted(self.cold_side, "deltaP")

        # Set solver options
        init_log = idaeslog.getInitLogger(self.name, outlvl, tag="unit")
        solve_log = idaeslog.getSolveLogger(self.name, outlvl, tag="unit")

        # Create solver
        opt = get_solver(solver, optarg)

        flags1 = self.hot_side.initialize(
            outlvl=outlvl, optarg=optarg, solver=solver, state_args=state_args_1
        )


        init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 1a (hot side) Complete.")

        flags2 = self.cold_side.initialize(
            outlvl=outlvl, optarg=optarg, solver=solver, state_args=state_args_2
        )
        init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 1b (cold side) Complete.")
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Solve unit without heat transfer equation
        self.heat_transfer_equation.deactivate()
        # Deactivate any additional constraints added to constrain outlet temperature/vapor fraction etc during initialisation.
        if hasattr( self.cold_side.properties_out, "_deactivate_additional_constraints"):
            self.cold_side.properties_out._deactivate_additional_constraints()
        if hasattr( self.hot_side.properties_out, "_deactivate_additional_constraints"):
            self.hot_side.properties_out._deactivate_additional_constraints()

        # Get side 1 and side 2 heat units, and convert duty as needed
        s1_units = self.hot_side.heat.get_units()
        s2_units = self.cold_side.heat.get_units()

        # Check to see if heat duty is fixed
        # WE will assume that if the first point is fixed, it is fixed at all points
        if not self.cold_side.heat[self.flowsheet().time.first()].fixed:
            cs_fixed = False
            if duty is None:
                # Assume 1000 J/s and check for unitless properties
                if s1_units is None and s2_units is None:
                    # Backwards compatibility for unitless properties
                    s1_duty = -1000
                    s2_duty = 1000
                else:
                    s1_duty = pyunits.convert_value(
                        -1000, from_units=pyunits.W, to_units=s1_units
                    )
                    s2_duty = pyunits.convert_value(
                        1000, from_units=pyunits.W, to_units=s2_units
                    )
            else:
                # Duty provided with explicit units
                s1_duty = -pyunits.convert_value(
                    duty[0], from_units=duty[1], to_units=s1_units
                )
                s2_duty = pyunits.convert_value(
                    duty[0], from_units=duty[1], to_units=s2_units
                )

            self.cold_side.heat.fix(s2_duty)
            for i in self.hot_side.heat:
                self.hot_side.heat[i].value = s1_duty
        else:
            cs_fixed = True
            for i in self.hot_side.heat:
                self.hot_side.heat[i].set_value(self.cold_side.heat[i])
        with idaeslog.solver_log(solve_log, idaeslog.DEBUG) as slc:
            res = opt.solve(self, tee=slc.tee)
        init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 2 {}.".format(idaeslog.condition(res)))
        if not cs_fixed:
            self.cold_side.heat.unfix()


        if hasattr( self.cold_side.properties_out, "_reactivate_additional_constraints"):
            self.cold_side.properties_out._reactivate_additional_constraints()
        if hasattr( self.hot_side.properties_out, "_reactivate_additional_constraints"):
            self.hot_side.properties_out._reactivate_additional_constraints()
        self.heat_transfer_equation.activate()

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Solve unit
        with idaeslog.solver_log(solve_log, idaeslog.DEBUG) as slc:
            res = opt.solve(self, tee=slc.tee)
        init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 3 {}.".format(idaeslog.condition(res)))
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        # Release Inlet state
        self.hot_side.release_state(flags1, outlvl=outlvl)
        self.cold_side.release_state(flags2, outlvl=outlvl)

        init_log.info("Initialization Completed, {}".format(idaeslog.condition(res)))

        if not check_optimal_termination(res):
            raise InitializationError(
                f"{self.name} failed to initialize successfully. Please check "
                f"the output logs for more information."
            )


    def diagnose(self) -> list[tuple[Component, str]]:
        """
        Test a few common issues with the heat exchanger model and provide hints to the user.
        returns a list with the variable the it is most relevant to and a message describing the issue
        """
        # if flow rates are drastically different and enthalpy rates are drastically different,
        # this might be a problem.
        problems = []
        mass_flow_difference = value(self.hot_side.properties_in[0].flow_mass)/value(self.cold_side.properties_in[0].flow_mass)
        if mass_flow_difference > 100:
            problems.append(
                (
                    self.hot_side.properties_in[0].flow_mass,
                    f"Mass flow rate on hot side is {mass_flow_difference:.2f} times higher than cold side. This may cause convergence issues. Consider adjusting the model or providing better initial guesses.",
                )
            )
        elif mass_flow_difference < 0.01:
            problems.append(
                (
                    self.cold_side.properties_in[0].flow_mass,
                    f"Mass flow rate on cold side is {1/mass_flow_difference:.2f} times higher than hot side. This may cause convergence issues. Consider adjusting the model or providing better initial guesses.",
                )
            )
        hsi_temp  = value(self.hot_side.properties_in[0].temperature) or 0
        csi_temp  = value(self.cold_side.properties_in[0].temperature) or 0
        hso_temp  = value(self.hot_side.properties_out[0].temperature) or 0
        cso_temp  = value(self.cold_side.properties_out[0].temperature) or 0
        if hsi_temp < csi_temp:
            # switch hot and cold side temps so hot side is always hotter.
            hsi_temp, csi_temp = csi_temp, hsi_temp
            hso_temp, cso_temp = cso_temp, hso_temp

        if hsi_temp - cso_temp < 1e-1:
            problems.append(
                (
                    self.overall_heat_transfer_coefficient,
                    f"The heat exchanger has used all the heat available in the hot side. Temperature difference between HS inlet and CS outlet is  ({hsi_temp - cso_temp:.2f} K). There needs to be a temperature difference to drive heat transfer. Perhaps there is insufficient energy in one of the streams.",
                )
            )
        elif hso_temp - csi_temp < 1e-1:
            problems.append(
                (
                    self.overall_heat_transfer_coefficient,
                    f"The heat exchanger has used all the cooling available in the cold side. Temperature difference between HS outlet and CS inlet is  ({hso_temp - csi_temp:.2f} K). There needs to be a temperature difference to drive heat transfer. Perhaps there is insufficient cooling in the cold side or too much heat in the hot side.",
                )
            )
        return problems

76: class IsentropicPressureChangerInitializer(SingleControlVolumeUnitInitializer):
77:     """
78:     Initializer for isentropic pressure changer models (and derived types).
79: 
80:     """
81: 
82:     def initialization_routine(
83:         self,
84:         model: Block,
85:     ):
86:         """
87:         Initialization routine for isentropic pressure changers.
88: 
89:         This routine starts by initializing the inlet and outlet states as usual,
90:         using the user provided operating conditions to estimate the outlet state.
91:         The isentropic state is then initialized at the same conditions as the outlet.
92:         Next, the pressure changer is solved with an isothermal assumption and fixed efficiency,
93:         followed by a second solve with the isentropic constraints. Finally, if user-provided
94:         performance constraints are present, these are activated and the model solved again.
95: 
96:         Args:
97:             model: model to be initialized
98: 
99:         Returns:
100:             Pyomo solver status object
101: 
102:         """
103:         init_log = idaeslog.getInitLogger(
104:             model.name, self.get_output_level(), tag="unit"
105:         )
106:         solve_log = idaeslog.getSolveLogger(
107:             model.name, self.get_output_level(), tag="unit"
108:         )
109: 
110:         # Create solver
111:         solver = self._get_solver()
112: 
113:         cv = model.control_volume
114: 
115:         # check if performance curves exist and are active
116:         activate_performance_curves = (
117:             hasattr(model, "performance_curve")
118:             and model.performance_curve.has_constraints()
119:             and model.performance_curve.active
120:         )
121:         if activate_performance_curves:
122:             model.performance_curve.deactivate()
123:             # The performance curves will provide (maybe indirectly) efficiency
124:             # and/or pressure ratio. To get through the standard isentropic
125:             # pressure changer init, we'll see if the user provided a guess for
126:             # pressure ratio or isentropic efficiency and fix them if needed. If
127:             # not fixed and no guess provided, fill in something reasonable
128:             # until the performance curves are turned on.
129:             unfix_eff = {}
130:             unfix_ratioP = {}
131:             for t in model.flowsheet().time:
132:                 if not (
133:                     model.ratioP[t].fixed
134:                     or model.deltaP[t].fixed
135:                     or cv.properties_out[t].pressure.fixed
136:                 ):
137:                     if model.config.compressor:
138:                         if not (
139:                             value(model.ratioP[t]) >= 1.01
140:                             and value(model.ratioP[t]) <= 50
141:                         ):
142:                             model.ratioP[t] = 1.8
143:                     else:
144:                         if not (
145:                             value(model.ratioP[t]) >= 0.01
146:                             and value(model.ratioP[t]) <= 0.999
147:                         ):
148:                             model.ratioP[t] = 0.7
149:                     model.ratioP[t].fix()
150:                     unfix_ratioP[t] = True
151:                 if not model.efficiency_isentropic[t].fixed:
152:                     if not (
153:                         value(model.efficiency_isentropic[t]) >= 0.05
154:                         and value(model.efficiency_isentropic[t]) <= 1.0
155:                     ):
156:                         model.efficiency_isentropic[t] = 0.8
157:                     model.efficiency_isentropic[t].fix()
158:                     unfix_eff[t] = True
159: 
160:         # Initialize state blocks
161:         self.initialize_control_volume(cv, copy_inlet_state=False)
162: 
163:         init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 1 Complete.")
164:         # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
165:         # Copy outlet state to isentropic state
166: 
167:         # Map solution from inlet properties to outlet properties
168:         state = to_json(
169:             cv.properties_out,
170:             wts=StoreSpec().value(),
171:             return_dict=True,
172:         )
173:         from_json(
174:             model.properties_isentropic,
175:             sd=state,
176:             wts=StoreSpec().value(only_not_fixed=True),
177:         )
178: 
179:         init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 2 Complete.")
180: 
181:         # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
182:         # Solve for isothermal conditions
183:         if isinstance(
184:             model.properties_isentropic[model.flowsheet().time.first()].temperature,
185:             Var,
186:         ):
187:             model.properties_isentropic[:].temperature.fix()
188:         elif isinstance(
189:             model.properties_isentropic[model.flowsheet().time.first()].enth_mol,
190:             Var,
191:         ):
192:             model.properties_isentropic[:].enth_mol.fix()
193:         elif isinstance(
194:             model.properties_isentropic[model.flowsheet().time.first()].temperature,
195:             Expression,
196:         ):
197: 
198:             def tmp_rule(blk, t):
199:                 return (
200:                     blk.properties_isentropic[t].temperature
201:                     == blk.control_volume.properties_in[t].temperature
202:                 )
203: 
204:             model.tmp_init_constraint = Constraint(
205:                 model.flowsheet().time, rule=tmp_rule
206:             )
207: 
208:         model.isentropic.deactivate()
209: 
210:         with idaeslog.solver_log(solve_log, idaeslog.DEBUG) as slc:
211:             res = solver.solve(model, tee=slc.tee)
212:         init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 3 {}.".format(idaeslog.condition(res)))
213: 
214:         # Revert changes for isothermal assumption
215:         if isinstance(
216:             model.properties_isentropic[model.flowsheet().time.first()].temperature,
217:             Var,
218:         ):
219:             model.properties_isentropic[:].temperature.unfix()
220:         elif isinstance(
221:             model.properties_isentropic[model.flowsheet().time.first()].enth_mol,
222:             Var,
223:         ):
224:             model.properties_isentropic[:].enth_mol.unfix()
225:         elif isinstance(
226:             model.properties_isentropic[model.flowsheet().time.first()].temperature,
227:             Expression,
228:         ):
229:             model.del_component(model.tmp_init_constraint)
230: 
231:         model.isentropic.activate()
232: 
233:         # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
234:         # Solve unit
235:         with idaeslog.solver_log(solve_log, idaeslog.DEBUG) as slc:
236:             res = solver.solve(model, tee=slc.tee)
237:         init_log.info_high("Initialization Step 4 {}.".format(idaeslog.condition(res)))
238: 
239:         if activate_performance_curves:
240:             model.performance_curve.activate()
241:             for t, v in unfix_eff.items():
242:                 if v:
243:                     model.efficiency_isentropic[t].unfix()
244:             for t, v in unfix_ratioP.items():
245:                 if v:
246:                     model.ratioP[t].unfix()
247:             with idaeslog.solver_log(solve_log, idaeslog.DEBUG) as slc:
248:                 res = solver.solve(model, tee=slc.tee)
249:             init_log.info_high(f"Initialization Step 5 {idaeslog.condition(res)}.")
250: 
251:         return res

279:             "These expressions can be used in performance curve constraints.",
280:         ),

293:                 @self.Expression(self.flowsheet().time)

297:                         return (

301:                     else:

322: 
323:             except PropertyNotSupportedError:

326:                     "property package but are required for isentropic pressure"
327:                     " changer head calculation"

329:                 raise

472:     def build(self):

474: 
475:         Args:
476:             None
477: 
478:         Returns:
479:             None
480:         """

482:         super().build()
483: 
484:         # Add a control volume to the unit including setting up dynamics.
485:         self.control_volume = ControlVolume0DBlock(
486:             dynamic=self.config.dynamic,
487:             has_holdup=self.config.has_holdup,
488:             property_package=self.config.property_package,

491: 
492:         # Add geometry variables to control volume
493:         if self.config.has_holdup:
494:             self.control_volume.add_geometry()
495: 
496:         # Add inlet and outlet state blocks to control volume
497:         self.control_volume.add_state_blocks(
498:             has_phase_equilibrium=self.config.has_phase_equilibrium
499:         )
500: 
501:         # Add mass balance
502:         # Set has_equilibrium is False for now
503:         # TO DO; set has_equilibrium to True
504:         self.control_volume.add_material_balances(
505:             balance_type=self.config.material_balance_type,
506:             has_phase_equilibrium=self.config.has_phase_equilibrium,
507:         )
508: 
509:         # Add energy balance
510:         eb = self.control_volume.add_energy_balances(
511:             balance_type=self.config.energy_balance_type, has_work_transfer=True
512:         )
513: 
514:         # add momentum balance
515:         self.control_volume.add_momentum_balances(
516:             balance_type=self.config.momentum_balance_type, has_pressure_change=True
517:         )
518: 
519:         # Add Ports
520:         self.add_inlet_port()
521:         self.add_outlet_port()
522: 
523:         # Set Unit Geometry and holdup Volume
524:         if self.config.has_holdup is True:
525:             self.volume = Reference(self.control_volume.volume[:])
526: 
527:         # Construct performance equations
528:         # Set references to balance terms at unit level
529:         # Add Work transfer variable 'work'
530:         # If the 'work' variable wasn't already built on the control volume but is needed, create it now.
531:         if (
532:             not hasattr(self.control_volume, "work")
533:             and self.config.thermodynamic_assumption == ThermodynamicAssumption.pump
534:             and eb is None
535:         ):
536:             units = (
537:                 self.control_volume.config.property_package.get_metadata().get_derived_units
538:             )
539:             self.control_volume.work = Var(
540:                 self.flowsheet().time,
541:                 domain=Reals,
542:                 initialize=0.0,
543:                 doc="Work transferred into control volume",
544:                 units=units("power"),
545:             )
546:         self.work_mechanical = Reference(self.control_volume.work[:])

548:         # Add Momentum balance variable 'deltaP'
549:         self.deltaP = Reference(self.control_volume.deltaP[:])
550: 
551:         # Performance Variables
552:         self.ratioP = Var(self.flowsheet().time, initialize=1.0, doc="Pressure Ratio")
553: 
554:         # Pressure Ratio
555:         @self.Constraint(self.flowsheet().time, doc="Pressure ratio constraint")
556:         def ratioP_calculation(self, t):
557:             return (
558:                 self.ratioP[t] * self.control_volume.properties_in[t].pressure
559:                 == self.control_volume.properties_out[t].pressure
560:             )
561: 
562:         # Construct equations for thermodynamic assumption
563:         if self.config.thermodynamic_assumption == ThermodynamicAssumption.isothermal:
564:             self.add_isothermal()
565:         elif self.config.thermodynamic_assumption == ThermodynamicAssumption.isentropic:
566:             self.add_isentropic()
567:         elif self.config.thermodynamic_assumption == ThermodynamicAssumption.pump:
568:             self.add_pump()
569:         elif self.config.thermodynamic_assumption == ThermodynamicAssumption.adiabatic:

572:     def add_pump(self):
573:         """
574:         Add constraints for the incompressible fluid assumption
575: 
576:         Args:
577:             None
578: 
579:         Returns:
580:             None
581:         """
582:         units_meta = self.control_volume.config.property_package.get_metadata()
583: 
584:         self.work_fluid = Var(
585:             self.flowsheet().time,
586:             initialize=1.0,
587:             doc="Work required to increase the pressure of the liquid",
588:             units=units_meta.get_derived_units("power"),
589:         )
590:         self.efficiency_pump = Var(
591:             self.flowsheet().time, initialize=1.0, doc="Pump efficiency"
592:         )
593: 
594:         @self.Constraint(self.flowsheet().time, doc="Pump fluid work constraint")
595:         def fluid_work_calculation(self, t):
596:             return self.work_fluid[t] == (
597:                 (
598:                     self.control_volume.properties_out[t].pressure
599:                     - self.control_volume.properties_in[t].pressure
600:                 )
601:                 * self.control_volume.properties_out[t].flow_vol
602:             )
603: 
604:         # Actual work
605:         @self.Constraint(
606:             self.flowsheet().time, doc="Actual mechanical work calculation"
607:         )
608:         def actual_work(self, t):
609:             if self.config.compressor:
610:                 return self.work_fluid[t] == (
611:                     self.work_mechanical[t] * self.efficiency_pump[t]
612:                 )
613:             else:
614:                 return self.work_mechanical[t] == (
615:                     self.work_fluid[t] * self.efficiency_pump[t]
616:                 )
617: 
618:     def add_isothermal(self):
619:         """
620:         Add constraints for isothermal assumption.
621: 
622:         Args:
623:             None
624: 
625:         Returns:
626:             None
627:         """
628: 
629:         # Isothermal constraint
630:         @self.Constraint(
631:             self.flowsheet().time,
632:             doc="For isothermal condition: Equate inlet and " "outlet temperature",
633:         )
634:         def isothermal(self, t):
635:             return (
636:                 self.control_volume.properties_in[t].temperature
637:                 == self.control_volume.properties_out[t].temperature
638:             )
639: 
640:     def add_adiabatic(self):
641:         """
642:         Add constraints for adiabatic assumption.
643: 
644:         Args:
645:             None
646: 
647:         Returns:
648:             None
649:         """
650: 
651:         @self.Constraint(self.flowsheet().time)
652:         def zero_work_equation(self, t):
653:             return self.control_volume.work[t] == 0
654: 
655:     def add_isentropic(self):
656:         """
657:         Add constraints for isentropic assumption.
658: 
659:         Args:
660:             None
661: 
662:         Returns:
663:             None
664:         """
665:         units_meta = self.control_volume.config.property_package.get_metadata()
666: 
667:         # Get indexing sets from control volume
668:         # Add isentropic variables
669:         self.efficiency_isentropic = Var(
670:             self.flowsheet().time,
671:             initialize=0.8,
672:             doc="Efficiency with respect to an isentropic process [-]",
673:         )
674:         self.work_isentropic = Var(
675:             self.flowsheet().time,
676:             initialize=0.0,
677:             doc="Work input to unit if isentropic process",
678:             units=units_meta.get_derived_units("power"),
679:         )
680: 
681:         # Build isentropic state block
682:         tmp_dict = dict(**self.config.property_package_args)
683:         tmp_dict["has_phase_equilibrium"] = self.config.has_phase_equilibrium
684:         tmp_dict["defined_state"] = False
685: 
686:         self.properties_isentropic = self.config.property_package.build_state_block(
687:             self.flowsheet().time, doc="isentropic properties at outlet", **tmp_dict
688:         )
689: 
690:         # Connect isentropic state block properties
691:         @self.Constraint(
692:             self.flowsheet().time, doc="Pressure for isentropic calculations"
693:         )
694:         def isentropic_pressure(self, t):
695:             return (
696:                 self.properties_isentropic[t].pressure
697:                 == self.control_volume.properties_out[t].pressure
698:             )
699: 
700:         # This assumes isentropic composition is the same as outlet
701:         self.add_state_material_balances(
702:             self.config.material_balance_type,
703:             self.properties_isentropic,
704:             self.control_volume.properties_out,
705:         )
706: 
707:         # This assumes isentropic entropy is the same as inlet
708:         @self.Constraint(self.flowsheet().time, doc="Isentropic assumption")
709:         def isentropic(self, t):
710:             return (
711:                 self.properties_isentropic[t].entr_mol
712:                 == self.control_volume.properties_in[t].entr_mol
713:             )
714: 
715:         # Isentropic work
716:         @self.Constraint(
717:             self.flowsheet().time, doc="Calculate work of isentropic process"
718:         )
719:         def isentropic_energy_balance(self, t):
720:             return self.work_isentropic[t] == (
721:                 sum(
722:                     self.properties_isentropic[t].get_enthalpy_flow_terms(p)
723:                     for p in self.properties_isentropic.phase_list
724:                 )
725:                 - sum(
726:                     self.control_volume.properties_in[t].get_enthalpy_flow_terms(p)
727:                     for p in self.control_volume.properties_in.phase_list
728:                 )
729:             )
730: 
731:         # Actual work
732:         @self.Constraint(
733:             self.flowsheet().time, doc="Actual mechanical work calculation"
734:         )
735:         def actual_work(self, t):
736:             if self.config.compressor:
737:                 return self.work_isentropic[t] == (
738:                     self.work_mechanical[t] * self.efficiency_isentropic[t]
739:                 )
740:             else:
741:                 return self.work_mechanical[t] == (
742:                     self.work_isentropic[t] * self.efficiency_isentropic[t]
743:                 )
744: 
745:         if self.config.support_isentropic_performance_curves:
746:             self.performance_curve = IsentropicPerformanceCurve(
747:                 **self.config.isentropic_performance_curves
748:             )
